rootCause.statement: the §4 Pass-A prerequisite gate in scripts/phase-3-601-clean-rerun.ts required inventoryStatus === 'INVENTORY_OK' from both passes. Both returned INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP, which is a SUCCESSFUL Pass A that produced 284 and 290 usable items and disclosed 16 unaccounted source stretches. The ensemble built with 322 canonical items. §4's enumerated stop conditions are: refused by the cost guard, throws, INVENTORY_FAILED, or no usable inventory due to harness/environment failure - none of which applied - and §4's own third requirement (ensemble successfully constructed) was met. The gate was stricter than its specification and killed the run before Pass B.
rootCause.sameShapeAsHd1: both defects were harness gates stricter than the specification they implemented; in both cases the over-strictness destroyed the run rather than protecting it
rootCause.perMissionRule: §13 requires STOP rather than patch-and-continue when a new harness defect is found after paid calls

whyNoRerunInThisMission.rule: §13 forbids patching and continuing after a defect discovered post-spend
